args.name: root-cultivation-trial
args.function: Provide a personally learnable method to assess and, where physically feasible, tend the existing planted root through a bounded cultivation experiment. Support persistent work, observation of actual outcomes, and harvesting only if real edible growth occurs.
args.conditions: The existing root-trial-10-moss-48 at (19.1,13.5) contains one reserved real root planted at tick 11. Its viability is unverified. Observed ordinary soil moisture is 0.65. The existing planting ability explicitly provides no propagation, tending or harvest rule. Do not assume this edible root can propagate.
args.inputs: Use the existing trial and its reserved root if suitable. Any additional material, tools or water must be identified and actually obtained; none is presumed available.
args.costs: Method, learning time, required work, elapsed growth time and material costs are unknown. Specify them before execution, including interruption and cancellation behavior.
args.effects: Enable an evidence-producing cultivation test with genuine failure possible. Preserve finite material accounting and existing ageing. Report only observable viability or growth evidence; produce no food unless actual cultivation supports it. No guaranteed propagation or yield, and no reward for requesting or learning.

reviews.reason: Related capabilities have been searched. root-planting-trial places and reserves a root but explicitly excludes cultivation and harvest; probe supplies individual observations, not a persistent cultivation assessment or safe access to the planted specimen. Develop a bounded assessment and inspection precursor, reusing those implementations. Propagation, edible yield and a beneficial tending treatment remain conditional on an actual supported physical mechanism, not on the root's name or the passage of time. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Study, requests, registration and merely waiting earn no experience benefit. Reuse existing probe feedback rather than adding a second cultivation reward path. Personally applicable, genuinely verified new evidence, including informative failure, may qualify once per actor and underlying fact/state transition; repeated observations of the same state do not. If the existing feedback implementation lacks an explicit bounded amount, cap, decay and cooldown, this precursor grants no additional pleasure or satisfaction until those rules are implemented. Familiar legitimate practice may qualify only through an existing bounded practice rule, never through automatic farming of inspection calls. Do not change protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and nutrition is independent of mood. Findings are not automatically communicated to others: other participants must observe or communicate and act independently.
reviews.visualReview: Retain the plot's existing reusable plant component and position. Add reusable metadata for trial ID, work ID, last observed tick, observation event references, remaining work, covered/exposed state, and uncertainty label. Separate actual visible evidence from internal simulation bookkeeping: show unverified, inspection-in-progress, interrupted, covered or exposed only when those events occur. Sprout, decay, maturity or harvest visuals require corresponding physical events and visible evidence; observation checkpoints, learning and completed inspection cannot display cultivation success. Failure emits a reason-coded event and preserves the truthful plot state. Do not reveal latent viability, hidden resources or unobserved biomass through visual metadata.
reviews.specification: Current-conversation development handoff: implement a persistent planted-root assessment with modes begin, observe, inspect, resume and cancel. Record reuse of root-planting-trial's reservation/progress/ageing code and open.probe's observation/evidence code; do not claim their reinvention. Target exactly root-trial-10-moss-48 at (19.1,13.5), whose reserved input is item-10-moss-47 from start-1-roots. Implement a paid, persistent loose-arrangement precursor, not a guaranteed bed or a new material recipe. Contract modes: quote, begin, resume, cancel, inspect, rest-trial; accept exact inputStackId, quantity in tenths, x/y, nominated footprint and, after creation, exact processId or arrangementId. Quote exposes requirements, costs and cancellation terms without advancing the world, changing material or awarding experience. Preconditions at execution: living actor with required individual study completed, sufficient spendable energy, owned unreserved moss, reachable in-bounds supporting ground and a visible unoccupied footprint; use existing reach/collision rules, with the root-placement reach of 0.65 plus body radius only where that shared validator applies. The known eligible stack is item-16-sol-76, moss, at most 0.9 unit, subject to live ownership, reach and reservation validation; root item-3-sol-12 is not an input. forest-moss-2 is not free material. Reference the prior evidence event-19-sol-94 and personal knowledge moss:load response:load-band-0 only for their actual measured conditions; do not generalize held=false at load 0.3 into bedding strength, thickness or comfort.
Smallest executable construction: gather the selected already-owned amount onto the nominated ground footprint and spread it as a loose, unbound trial layer. No tools, binder, water, heating, clearing or harvested stock are supplied. The amount is an experiment input, not a claimed minimum bedding recipe. The handoff must expose the permitted footprint geometry and quantity range before commitment, and implement only geometry/material placement supported by actual units; no invented mass-to-volume conversion or full-body coverage. Two completed construction rounds cost 1 energy each. Begin reserves the exact selected quantity and footprint and performs the first paid placement step; the second paid step spreads the material and records the resulting occupied geometry and whatever coverage can actually be established. Each round revalidates access, occupancy and resources. Persist per-step work, exact escrow, transferred quantities, placed geometry and observed obstructions. If even loose placement cannot be supported, stop with the paid steps and real material disposition recorded, without a completed-pad claim. Additional necessary processing or inputs must be identified and separately accepted before consumption; this precursor does not silently add them.
Conservation: debit each selected tenth from its source exactly once and track it as reserved, placed, recovered, lost through a real modeled event, or remaining in the source. The product is an owned persistent loose-moss trial arrangement containing only the moss actually placed, not extra inventory, a fabricated facility, or a guaranteed usable pad. Construction completion means placement completed; usability is a separate status: untested, tested usable for the explicitly tested contact conditions, failed, or inconclusive. Existing material ageing and environmental processes continue if applicable; if no durability mechanism exists, durability remains unknown. Inspection does not repair anything. Further placement/repair requires actual material and paid work through the same contract, with its incremental costs quoted first.
Inspection costs one completed round and 0.2 energy, requires reachable arrangementId, and records only visible material presence, spread, displacement and observable condition. Do not charge an additional observation round for the same rest event. Record pre/post energy, actual recovery, contact/coverage if measurable, displacement and any directly supported failure. No load, temperature, insulation, softness, compression, survival or durability improvement may be inferred from the name or previous flexibility result.
